name: Instrumental with-PP
pattern: PP[with + instrument NP] as an adjunct

entry.name: Instrumental with-PP
entry.pattern: PP[with + instrument NP] as an adjunct

1.definition: Identifies an object that mediates or enables an action.

examples.form: Lee opened the case [with a small screwdriver].

projection.target: A screwdriver has a means role here. With the watchman can instead identify an accompanying participant under a distinct interpretation.
projection.evidence: See the cited discussion and the constructed illustration.

curious.title: Doing something with a tool
curious.summary: A phrase with with and a thing can name what was used to do something.
curious.body: In Lee opened the case with a small screwdriver, the phrase with a small screwdriver names what Lee used. The screwdriver helped the action happen. The same words with can introduce someone who came along, as in with the watchman. That's a different meaning, so the sentence around it matters.

examples.text: Lee opened the case [with a small screwdriver].
She stirred the soup [with a wooden spoon].

curious.try: Say Lee opened the case with a screwdriver, then Lee opened the case with the watchman. How does the meaning of with change?

teacher.summary: Covers with plus a noun phrase naming the instrument used in an action.
teacher.explain: The pattern is a prepositional phrase of with plus an instrument noun phrase, used as an adjunct. It identifies an object that mediates or enables an action: in Lee opened the case with a small screwdriver, the screwdriver has a means role. With the watchman can instead identify an accompanying participant, which is a distinct interpretation. This dictionary treats the phrase as a specialization of the prepositional phrase and relates it to by plus gerund means phrases. It is provisional.
teacher.terms: Traditionally called an adverbial of instrument. This dictionary treats it as an adjunct prepositional phrase.

examples.text: Lee opened the case [with a small screwdriver].
She stirred the soup [with a wooden spoon].

contrasts.text: Lee opened the case with a small screwdriver.
Lee opened the case with the watchman.

watch_for: A learner might read with the watchman as naming a tool.
A learner might think every with-phrase names an accompanying person.
teacher.activity: Students ask How did you do it? about classroom actions and answer with with plus a tool. They then replace the tool with a person and discuss how the meaning shifts.

child.hook: What do you use to do things, and how do you say it?
child.explain: With can name a tool you used. Lee opened the case with a small screwdriver. The screwdriver is what helped him do it.

examples.text: Lee opened the case [with a small screwdriver].
I drew the picture [with a blue pen].

child.play: Act out a job without saying the tool. A partner says what you did, ending with the tool, such as "with a spoon."
